BenchLM Reasoning Leaderboard

The BenchLM Reasoning Leaderboard scores general-purpose language models on a private held-out set of multi-step reasoning problems. Scores are the mean of three runs and are reported out of 100. This page introduces the methodology; the ranking table follows below. Nothing in this introductory paragraph contains an individual model score.

Evaluated on the BenchLM-Reasoning v4 suite. Population: 14 models that completed all three runs. Models that failed a run are excluded from the ranking.
